pinned_source.completed_result_applied: Localized Theorem A: a physical 3x3 principal block with all eigenvalues of modulus at least c gives density cap 6 sqrt(pi)/c, affine-uniform.

partner_source.result_used: QFORM-CONJUGATE-DIFFERENCE-CURVATURE-HALFRIESZ-v1; its det(K) inverse-quarter bound is applied for delta != 0 and its exact singular endpoint is tested by the new family.

new_result.statement: For lambda>=1 and |delta|<=lambda/2, the conjugate family P_-=lambda[[0,1],[1,0]], P_+=(lambda+delta)I has a target-valid physical 4x4 matrix while every physical 2D determinant certificate vanishes at delta=0 and degenerates as delta->0. Every physical 3x3 principal block nevertheless has min absolute eigenvalue at least c0 lambda, c0=8/(sqrt(41)+3), so the pinned localized theorem gives ||p_Q||_infty <= [3(3+sqrt(41))/4]sqrt(pi)/lambda. The resulting half-Riesz and whole-copy weighted-time bounds stay uniform through delta=0.

dependence_scope: U=X-Y and V=X+Y remain dependent; all probabilistic estimates use the original independent physical coordinates. The only independent-copy identity used is for an independent copy of the whole scalar output Q.
unresolved_implication: In the general double-singular collar where all physical 2D determinant certificates are small, prove a product-preserving alternative: either a quantitatively nondegenerate physical 3x3 principal block exists, or the matrix routes to an already-paid grouped-hub, low-rank-carrier, or projected-volume receiver. A universal good triple/rank-three-cut claim is forbidden by existing corrections.
